lines.zh: 我迈着很长的腿走过去。
lines.en: I stride past on long legs.
I plant each foot carefully.

lines.zh: 我从末地的石头上走过。
lines.en: I walk the end stone.
I walk a little tilted.

lines.zh: 我绕过一块紫色的方块。
lines.en: I go around a patch of violet.
I step over a crack.
My tail scrapes the sand the whole way.
I take a few steps toward you.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方草伏下去。
lines.en: The grass lies down where I pass.
I pass along the edge of the trees.
I walk slowly to open ground.
I stand with my long neck lowered.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地上扒了扒。
lines.en: I rake the ground with a claw.
I'm dark coloured.
I'm watching something far off.

lines.zh: 我蹲在锚点边，慢慢甩尾。
lines.en: I crouch by my anchor and swing my tail slowly.
I can rest standing up.
I lower my head and sniff the soil.
I can hold one breath a long while.

lines.zh: 我把一边的翅膀收了收。
lines.en: I tuck one wing in.
There's already a little light at the sky's edge.

lines.zh: 我把一条腿收起来歇着。
lines.en: I take one leg up to rest.
Wind comes off the open ground.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，你站在我脚边。
lines.en: I look down; you're at my feet.
I reach out one claw.
The top of your head reaches my chest.

lines.zh: 我低头闻了闻你的味道。
lines.en: I lower my head and sniff your scent.
I don't strike at once.

lines.zh: 你把重量放在一条腿上。
lines.en: You're resting your weight on one leg.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在土里留了痕。
lines.en: My claw leaves a line in the soil.
You're looking at my claws.
You haven't shouted once — good.
I'm waiting for you to step away.
Your hands have stayed down.
I lower my neck a little.
The soil under you is loose.
I turn my head your way.

lines.zh: 我还没有决定要不要动。
lines.en: I haven't decided whether to move.
You had better not run.
I take a step and tilt.
One of my legs snapped right there.
I look down at myself.
My claws pull back.
I brace on the ground.
My colour deepens.
I make no sound.
I straighten my neck again.
Blood runs down into the soil.
Wounded like this, I still get up.
That wouldn't fill me.

lines.zh: 这东西我收着也没处用。
lines.en: I've nowhere to put this to use.
I prefer what's in the soil.
Its smell is too thin.
I turn back toward the dune.
I stop again and look at you.
I sniff twice and walk off.
That gives me nothing.
That didn't move me.
I step back to give room.
A claw tip grazes your shoulder.
Sand turns over between us.

lines.zh: 你撞在我腿上，爪子没停。
lines.en: You hit my leg; my claws keep moving.
I stand completely still.
I don't stop; I walk on as before.
I've gone around you.
She has long legs too.
Her colour is paler than mine.
Two heads come down together.

lines.zh: 我们的爪子搭在同一块石头上。
lines.en: Our claws rest on the same stone.
Neither of us makes a sound.
She heads for the open; I follow.

lines.zh: 我们把沙地踩出两行印。
lines.en: Two lines of prints cross the sand.
This ground is enough for us both.
She stops and looks back.
I lower my head and pick it up.
I turn it over with a claw.
I bury it back.
I rake the soil twice more.
This was buried deep.
I set it aside.
I keep digging in the soil.

lines.zh: 这个能当我的收藏品吗？
lines.en: Can this be my collection piece?
I've seen it, and I go still.
I lower my head at you.
My claws close a little.
This pale sand is my ground.
I lock on and my claws tighten.
I raise a claw.
There's no need for me to shout.
You weigh too little.
I've measured this one.
I'm setting off for you now.
I'll be right in front of you.

lines.zh: 我长腿跨过灌木，逼近你。
lines.en: My long legs step over the brush and close in.
My long legs cover ground fast.
You're running on sand.

lines.zh: 我的影子盖住整片黄沙。
lines.en: My shadow covers the whole stretch of yellow sand.
I extend my claws.
I get ahead of you.
You look up into my shadow.
I'm waiting for you to pause.

lines.zh: 我把身子侧过来，爪子亮了。
lines.en: I angle my body; my claws show.
I lift the claw as high as it goes.
This one has to land.
I bring the claw down.
My claws split the sand.
Three furrows remain in the ground.
Your armor tears open.
I pin you with a long leg.
You strike me, and it's light.
I bring the claw down again.
I lower my head and butt you.
You climb back up.
I raise the claw again.

lines.zh: 我的爪劈下去，碎石乱飞。
lines.en: My claw comes down and stone chips fly.

lines.zh: 我从末地的石头缝里站起来。
lines.en: I rise out of a crack in the end stone.
My legs straighten one joint at a time.
The ground here is pale yellow.
I work the joints of my legs open.

lines.zh: 我低头看了看自己的影子。
lines.en: I look down at my own shadow.

lines.zh: 我从末地石缝里伸直腿。
lines.en: I straighten my legs out of an End stone crack.
I could plant things here.
These claws grip the ground best.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的腿，我踩了两下。
lines.en: Fire catches my leg and I stamp at it.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下来，腿折了。
lines.en: I fall from a height and a leg buckles.
Water rises past my neck.
The blast slides me along the ground.
Too hungry to lift a leg.

lines.zh: 雷落在我背上，我低下了头。
lines.en: Lightning hits my back and my head drops.

lines.zh: 四周空空的，我一直往下。
lines.en: Empty all around; I keep going down.
